north.evidence: Pramanik 2003-04 Fig. 2 (PDF page 69, printed page 59): an eight-rayed compass star at the upper right with one long ray; no letter, legend or text giving its meaning was legible. The line was measured from the tip of the short ray opposite the long ray to the tip of the long ray.

scale.note: Scale-bar labels are illegible in the scan. Seven label marks sit under the bar, a short subdivided division left of the third and four equal divisions right of it, read as 10 5 0 10 20 30 40 m; this reading makes the enclosure's south side about 210 m, close to the 220 m by 225 m outer fortification stated in the report text (OCR of PDF page 64). Lengths carry this assumption.

lines.identification: west line of the straight double line on the east side of the enclosure east of the citadel, read as the outer fortification wall described in the report text (220 m by 225 m, rubble); the plan legend is illegible; Pramanik 2003-2004, 'Excavation at Juni Kuran 2003-04: A Preliminary Report', Puratattva 34, Fig. 2 'Kuran : Drawing showing the mound & the excavated area at Kuran-2004', PDF page 69, printed page 59.

northern line of the straight double line on the south side of the same enclosure, read as the outer fortification wall described in the report text (220 m by 225 m, rubble); the plan legend is illegible; Pramanik 2003-2004, 'Excavation at Juni Kuran 2003-04: A Preliminary Report', Puratattva 34, Fig. 2 'Kuran : Drawing showing the mound & the excavated area at Kuran-2004', PDF page 69, printed page 59.

single line on the north side of the enclosure, east of the gateway-like block beside the reservoir, running to the north-east corner; read as the outer fortification; Pramanik 2003-2004, Puratattva 34, Fig. 2, PDF page 69, printed page 59.
single line from the citadel's north-east corner toward the reservoir, read as the western part of the enclosure's north wall; Pramanik 2003-2004, Puratattva 34, Fig. 2, PDF page 69, printed page 59.
